name: comp-407
description: Renders a group of four circular avatars at 64px size with negative margins to create an overlap effect. Each avatar has a ring-2 border using theme background color.
use_when: Very large avatar groups for hero testimonials or spotlight sections where avatars need to command attention.
avoid_when: More than four avatars or when you need individual avatar state — this is a static group layout.
a11y: Each image has alt text. No interactive elements or motion; passive layout.
